dramatic_engine.pacing: Controlled prestige pacing: deliberate when awe is needed, compressed when exposition threatens momentum, and explosive only at genuine dramatic turns.
dramatic_engine.scene_design: Each scene requires objective, pressure, turn, image-system, sound intention, and a transition that increases narrative force.

evidence_role: Evidence is the factual backbone and safety boundary; it must not force a lecture, talking-head, slideshow, or dry documentary presentation style.
forbidden_failure_modes: Invented dialogue presented as historical fact
mandatory_principles: Cinematic dramatic construction rather than information dumping
Character-centred emotional progression without invented doctrine
Visual storytelling, subtext, silence, rhythm, and escalation
Every scene must carry dramatic function and visual authorship
World-building through scale, atmosphere, texture, sound, and light
Prestige-series continuity across episodes and seasons
Evidence-bound narration with clear qualification where required
Religious visual safety without sacrificing cinematic power
No depiction of Allah, angels, prophets, or the unseen as literal bodies
Symbolic and environmental imagery must remain non-assertive
quality_ambition: Compete in dramatic power, visual authorship, narrative precision, atmosphere, pacing, and emotional impact with the greatest historical cinema and prestige series.

principles: sound perspective establishes scale and presence
narration must interact with picture rather than duplicate it
monumental scale balanced with intimate human detail
distinct visual motif for every thematic movement
coherent colour, texture, lens, and lighting systems
transitions motivated by image, motion, sound, or idea
